type: industrial manufacturer — HIGHLY TRANSFERABLE for B2B/industrial/engineering clients

colors.accent: none (photography carries colour: navy machine, cyan tape)

fonts.display: grotesk 500 ~56-72px/1.05 ls -0.02em, headline sits bottom-left of hero
fonts.labels: mono 11-12px uppercase for captions/markers ('CONVENTIONAL / STRAIGHT FIBER COMPOSITES')

moves: hero: full-bleed VIDEO of the machine; headline bottom-left; 1-sentence claim mid-right; scroll-down button bottom-right; nav as mono pills top-right
'register marks' (tiny corner squares/dots) framing panels — technical-drawing feel
BEFORE/AFTER comparison: two bordered panels side by side, mono label top-left, 3D object centred, pill hotspot 'BEFORE RTS ⊕', result stat bottom
dark 3D object section with HOTSPOT PILLS ('AT SCALE ⊕', 'ZERO DEFECTS ⊕', '10× FASTER ⊕') on a faint grid
photo pairs full-bleed 2-up (machine | human with part)
text-only 2-col 'Our advantage': label + 3-line headline left; paragraph + 3 label/text pairs right
manifesto paragraph where the first words are grey and the rest fills to white on scroll (text scrub)
HORIZONTAL SCROLL process timeline 01…07: number, dotted rule with a dot, photo, mono caption
testimonial cards with quote mark, dark rounded
mobile: hero headline moves to top, claim bottom; panels stack; timeline becomes vertical/horizontal swipe
rules_derived: photography + mono labels + register marks = 'engineering precision' concept without any 3D
hotspot pills on a product image = cheapest 'interactive product' feel
numbered horizontal process is a strong pattern for any 'how we work'
no accent colour needed when photos are strong; the grid and labels do the design
